{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values in the biomarker_baseline column
missing_baseline = df['biomarker_baseline'].isnull().sum()

# Check the distribution of biomarker_baseline
baseline_stats = df['biomarker_baseline'].describe()

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value
mean_baseline = df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Return results
(missing_baseline, baseline_stats, mean_baseline)"}
